A.explanation: This is from the centre of a compression to the centre of the adjacent rarefaction, which is only half a wavelength $\lambda/2$.

B.explanation: This is from the centre of one compression to the centre of the next identical compression, which is one full wavelength $\lambda$.

C.explanation: This reaches the next rarefaction after one full cycle, a distance of about $1.5\lambda$ from the start.

D.explanation: This spans two compressions beyond the start, a distance of about $2\lambda$.
